help.text:
🍽️ FoodBot helps you track recipes and decide what to cook.

➕ Add food — add a recipe to your personal list or the shared global list: name, prep time, category, ingredients (tap existing ones, type a few letters to search a long list, or type a full new name to add it), then an optional recipe. You'll get a chance to review and fix anything before it's saved.

🍳 What can I cook? — pick a time preset (or type one), say what you have and whether you can shop, then tap any suggested food to see what you have vs. need to buy, plus its recipe.

🔍 Search recipe — type a food name (or part of it, like "ghorme" for Ghormeh Sabzi) and the closest matches show up; if nothing matches by name, it checks ingredients instead. One match shows the recipe right away, more than one shows tappable buttons to pick from. On a food from your own personal list, you'll also see a "⚙️ Settings" button to ✏️ Edit or 🗑️ Delete it. Foods on the global list can only be edited or deleted by the admin.

🌐 Language — switch between English and Persian anytime.

💬 Feedback — send a message straight to the admin.

/cancel — cancel whatever you're doing.

/help — show this message.
